items.title: Predictive Outcomes in Machine Learning (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Predictive Outcomes in Machine Learning' under topic 6.9 (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Predictive outcomes woh nataij hain jo train kiya hua model deta hai. Model pichhle data se andaze lagata hai, aur yeh nataij aane wali values ya waqiat (events) ka andaza hote hain. Andaze ki accuracy data ki quality par munhasir hai, aur achhi training andaze behtar karti hai. Misal: businesses market ya products ki farokht ke trends ka andaza lagane ke liye predictions istemal karte hain, aur healthcare mein diagnosis (bimari pehchanne) ke liye. Predictions behtar faislon mein madad deti hain.
